text: AGENTS says native Read/Grep/Glob for file inspection (to avoid permission prompts); the harness's auto-mode instruction says do reads via Bash. Two norms conflicted at the top of the session; resolved toward Bash for reads since auto mode removes the prompt friction AGENTS was written against — the native-tools norm should say it is ABOUT prompts, so it relaxes under auto mode.

A backticked word inside a git commit -m "..." message was swallowed by bash as a command substitution (`not` → ran the command 'not', substituted empty) — the commit went through with the word missing; AGENTS' Write/Edit-for-quoted-text norm names quotes but not backticks. Fix: commit messages that carry backticks go through -F <file>. Cost: an amend + a second 8-minute hook run.

preview_start returns before the page has loaded: a getComputedStyle probe in the same turn reads UA defaults (13.33px buttons, black text, zero stylesheets) and looks like a catastrophic regression; bit twice in one session (96a, 96d). Reload + wait + assert document.styleSheets.length before believing a number.

the hidden Browser pane runs no requestAnimationFrame, so a fade-in class flip (fade.ts) can never be observed there and the sim clock sits at tick 0; every render-timing claim has to be handed to the user's eye or driven by hand (world.tick + renderer.update). rafFiredDuring: 0 is the tell.

preview pane: the frozen rendering loop stalls the Web Animations API too, not only rAF — an orb animation sat at currentTime 50 ms with visibilityState visible and a programmatic finish() never fired its event; cost one probe cycle at 96.5b2 before the wall-clock backstop made the pane a valid wiring instrument

preview_start zero-stylesheet trap bit twice more this session (sheets 0 / __game undefined on the first probe, once even after a 7 s wait); the reload + wait rule holds but the wait is not a fixed number
navigate to the preview URL was denied once immediately after preview_start (the tab already at that URL); location.reload() via javascript_tool worked as the fallback

an npm update notice on stderr fills the tail of a piped vitest run — the docs-guard result never printed and the commit was chained onto an unread result; pipe through grep -v 'npm notice' before tail, or read the hook's own run

The Codex PowerShell PATH exposes node but not npm. The installed npm.cmd is at C:/Program Files/nodejs; the commit hook needs that directory added to the process PATH before it can run the required checks.

Launching the discovered npm.cmd inside the sandbox failed with Access is denied; a redirected attempt also reported StandardOutputEncoding and returned exit 0 despite not running tests. An approved unsandboxed run was required. The error text, not that exit code, established that verification had not run.
